sql:
SELECT '#18' AS source, COALESCE(CAST("#os" AS VARCHAR),'NULL') AS event_os, COUNT(DISTINCT "#account_id") AS new_role_accounts
FROM ta.v_event_18
WHERE "$part_date"='2026-07-29' AND "$part_event"='new_role'
GROUP BY 1,2
UNION ALL
SELECT '#13', COALESCE(CAST("#os" AS VARCHAR),'NULL'), COUNT(DISTINCT "#account_id")
FROM ta.v_event_13
WHERE "$part_date"='2026-05-08' AND "$part_event"='new_role'
GROUP BY 1,2
UNION ALL
SELECT '#18 fixed_os', COALESCE(tag_value,'NULL'), COUNT(DISTINCT "#user_id")
FROM user_result_cluster_18 WHERE cluster_name='fixed_os' GROUP BY 1,2
UNION ALL
SELECT '#13 fixed_os', COALESCE(tag_value,'NULL'), COUNT(DISTINCT "#user_id")
FROM user_result_cluster_13 WHERE cluster_name='fixed_os' GROUP BY 1,2
ORDER BY 1,2;
